title: Name what merging before finalize actually costs
description: name what merging before finalize actually costs
no_spec_change_rationale: diagnostic wording within existing module contracts; the warning gains the second-order cost it always had, extracted to a pure function so it can be pinned; no spec text changes
acceptance_criteria: The merge-before-finalize warning names the cost that lands on other changes, not only the one being merged: it states that merging first blocks every earlier accepted change sharing a delivery input from archiving until this one is finalized or those are reopened. The wording is pinned by a test on a pure function, so a later refactor cannot silently shrink it back. All four sites carry the corrected cost, including the CLI help text.
